mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, user_id, total_amount, status, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, create_time FROM `dingdan` ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id, order_no, user_id, total_amount, status, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, create_time FROM `dingdan` WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `dingdan` (order_no, user_id, total_amount, status, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, create_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverAddress}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE `dingdan` SET order_no = #{orderNo}, user_id = #{userId}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, status = #{status}, receiver_name = #{receiverName}, receiver_phone = #{receiverPhone}, receiver_address = #{receiverAddress} WHERE id = #{id}
